newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland invites bids for drugs maker Polpharma.
newsitem.headline: Poland invites bids for drugs maker Polpharma.

text.p: The Polish treasury ministry is inviting bids for at least 10-percent stakes in pharmaceuticals firm Polpharma SA, the ministry said in a newspaper announcement on Wednesday.
The ministry said up to 15 percent of shares in the firm, based in Starogard Gdanski, northern Poland, would be offered free of charge to the firm's employees.
It said 10 percent of the shares would be earmarked to support the country's social security reform and five percent for a planned fund to meet claims for property taken under communism. @
The ministry said the investors could place the initial offers by July 9.
